texts.t: Siena brings the same intelligence to video that transformed how you handle images. Warranty claims, damage assessments, and product guidance are handled automatically.
Help me choose a rug that matches my living room style
This rug would fit your space perfectly, here is my top pick!
Customers show you damaged products on video. Siena watches, understands, and resolves claims without your team ever pressing play.
My headphones came damaged out-of-the-box, is this covered by the warranty?
When customers show instead of tell, Siena gets the full picture. Visual context means faster resolution and happier customers.
I can see the damage. Your replacement ships today
My headphones came damaged out-of-the-box, is this covered by the warranty?
Every video ticket used to mean watching, pausing, screenshotting, and documenting. Siena handles all of it instantly so your team focuses on work that matters.
Your grind is too coarse. Try a finer setting and tamp with more pressure.
My espresso is coming out watery. Can you see what I'm doing wrong?
Customers send videos through Live Chat, Helpdesks or integrations like Hark. Siena picks them up automatically, no configuration needed.
Siena watches every frame and extracts what matters. Damaged products, missing parts, shipping issues, defects. Context your team would spend minutes gathering.
Claims processed, tickets updated, customers answered. What used to take manual review now happens instantly, at any volume.
See how fast-growing brands scale with Siena
